title: Leftovers are recorded when made and removed only when proven finished: backlog.py own, a safe_to_remove verdict in tidy, a kbmon cleanup panel
goal: backlog.py own records each worktree, sandbox, scratch directory and worker process this clone's tools make as a coord own/ key; backlog.py tidy lists every candidate with the verdict, reason and bytes of one safe_to_remove function and removes only the safe set under the operator's permission decision; land, close and SessionStart run it for their own leftovers or as a one-line report; merged remote code branches and recorded orphan processes are removed only by an operator command; kbmon's cleanup panel and a selfcheck line show the leftover counts
